caption:
Simple habit: 💳

1. Autopay at least the minimum so you never miss a due date.
2. Pay extra by hand when you can.
3. Check your statement monthly.

On-time payment history is a big part of your score.

What's your due-date trick?
first_comment: Autopay or calendar reminder, which do you use? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Which reminder works for you? Tell @creditscoretruths 👇

card.headline: Autopay the minimum. Pay extra by hand.
